title: Kissed Portuguese Buchu Stew
description: A mustardy, silky Portuguese stew with Asian chives and buchu, pressure‑cooked for comfort and diabetic‑friendly ease.

ingredients.name: chopped asian chives and buchu leaves

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a pressure cooker over medium heat until shimmering.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about two minutes.
Stir in the minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds, letting the aroma release.
Mix in the Dijon mustard, cumin, smoked paprika, a pinch of salt and pepper, cooking for another minute.
Add the chicken cubes and sear until lightly browned on all sides, about three minutes.
Pour in the chicken broth and then add cauliflower, zucchini, and diced tomatoes, stirring gently.
Seal the pressure cooker, set to high pressure, and cook for five minutes.
Quick‑release the pressure, stir in the asian chives and buchu leaves, adjust seasoning, and serve hot.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
